properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.upstream-liveness-probe-enabled
properties.description: Whether upstream liveness probing is enabled for proxied SSE/streamable-HTTP sessions. When enabled, idle sessions are probed with JSON-RPC ping requests and torn down on transport-level failure.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.timeouts.upstream-probe-interval
properties.description: Interval between upstream liveness probes for proxied sessions. The prober runs on a fixed delay and checks every active session.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.timeouts.upstream-probe-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for each upstream liveness probe. Applied both to the sendMessage POST and to the JSON-RPC answer deadline. A half-open upstream that accepts the POST but never responds is also detected.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.timeouts.upstream-probe-idle-threshold
properties.description: How long a proxied session may see no upstream traffic before the first liveness probe is sent. Only browser-initiated frames count as activity; probe traffic does not reset the timer.
